local _LPH_SRC = ""
local _LPH_KEY = [[]]
local OUT_STRINGS   = "luraph_strings_dump.txt"
local OUT_PROTOS    = "luraph_protos_dump.tsv"
local OUT_OBJECTS   = "luraph_objects_dump.tsv"
local OUT_RELATIONS = "luraph_relations_dump.tsv"
local OUT_CONSTANTS = "luraph_constants_dump.tsv"
local OUT_VALUES    = "luraph_values_dump.tsv"
local OUT_META      = "luraph_metadata.txt"
local OUT_DEBUG     = "luraph_env_debug.txt"
local OUT_ERRORS    = "luraph_errors.txt"
local OUT_REFS      = "luraph_refs_dump.txt"
local MAX_FIELD        = 64
local MAX_ARRAY_SCAN   = 16384
local MAX_TABLE_KEYS   = 8192
local MAX_RECURSION    = 12
local MAX_CANDIDATES   = 50000
local MAX_STRING_LEN   = 8192
local MAX_FN_SCAN      = 50000
local MAX_VALUE_OUTPUT = 200000
local MAX_WALK_ITEMS   = 400000
local MIN_PROTO_SCORE  = 10
local MIN_CODE_LENGTH  = 2
local warn_fn = (type(warn)=="function" and warn)
             or (type(print)=="function" and print)
             or function() end
local ERRS = {}
local function log_err(where, err)
    ERRS[#ERRS+1] = where .. ": " .. tostring(err)
end
local GENV = (function()
    if type(getgenv) == "function" then
        local ok,g = pcall(getgenv)
        if ok and type(g)=="table" then return g end
    end
    return _G
end)()
local function install_key(k)
    if not k or k == "" then return end

    local function put(t, name)
        if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
        local ok = pcall(function() t[name] = k end)
        if not ok then
            pcall(rawset, t, name, k)
        end
    end

    for _, tname in ipairs({ "SCRIPT_KEY","script_key","ScriptKey","Key","KEY" }) do
        put(GENV, tname)
        put(_G,   tname)
    end

    if type(getrenv)=="function" then
        local ok, renv = pcall(getrenv)
        if ok and type(renv)=="table" then
            for _, tname in ipairs({ "SCRIPT_KEY","script_key" }) do put(renv, tname) end
        end
    end

    if type(getfenv)=="function" then
        local ok, fenv0 = pcall(getfenv, 0)
        if ok and type(fenv0)=="table" then
            for _, tname in ipairs({ "SCRIPT_KEY","script_key" }) do put(fenv0, tname) end
        end
    end

    if type(getrawmetatable)=="function" and type(setreadonly)=="function" then
        local ok, mt = pcall(getrawmetatable, _G)
        if ok and type(mt)=="table" then
            local ok2, oldIdx = pcall(function() return mt.__index end)
            if not ok2 then oldIdx = nil end
            pcall(setreadonly, mt, false)
            pcall(function()
                mt.__index = function(t, key)
                    if key == "SCRIPT_KEY" or key == "script_key"
                       or key == "ScriptKey" or key == "KEY" then
                        return k
                    end
                    if type(oldIdx) == "function" then
                        return oldIdx(t, key)
                    elseif type(oldIdx) == "table" then
                        return oldIdx[key]
                    end
                    return nil
                end
            end)
            pcall(setreadonly, mt, true)
        end
    end
end

install_key(_LPH_KEY)

local dbg = (type(debug)=="table") and debug or {}

local function resolve_fn(names, ...)
    for _, src in ipairs({...}) do
        if type(src)=="table" then
            for _, n in ipairs(names) do
                local v = rawget(src, n)
                if type(v)=="function" then return v, n end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil, nil
end

local writefile_fn, writefile_name = resolve_fn(
    {"writefile","write_file","writeFile"}, _G, GENV)
local getreg_fn, getreg_name = resolve_fn(
    {"getreg","get_registry"}, _G, GENV)
local getrunning_fn = resolve_fn({"getrunningscripts"}, _G, GENV)
local getscripts_fn = resolve_fn({"getscripts"}, _G, GENV)
local getnilinst_fn = resolve_fn({"getnilinstances"}, _G, GENV)
local getinsts_fn   = resolve_fn({"getinstances"}, _G, GENV)
local getclosure_fn = resolve_fn(
    {"getscriptclosure","getscriptfunction"}, _G, GENV)
local getrenv_fn    = resolve_fn({"getrenv"}, _G, GENV)
local getupval_fn   = dbg.getupvalue
local getfenv_fn    = getfenv

local tracrefs_fn = dbg.tracrefs or dbg.tracerefs
local dumpheap_fn = dbg.dumpheap

local function emit(name, content)
    content = content or ""
    if writefile_fn then
        local ok = pcall(writefile_fn, name, content)
        if ok then return true end
    end
    warn_fn(("[dump] (console) %s : %d bytes"):format(name, #content))
    return false
end

local function fromhex(h)
    return (h:gsub("..", function(c) return string.char(tonumber(c,16) or 0) end))
end
local SRC = fromhex(_LPH_SRC)

local function spawn(fn)
    if type(task)=="table" and type(task.spawn)=="function" then
        return task.spawn(fn)
    end
    return coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(fn))
end
local function wait_(t)
    if type(task)=="table" and type(task.wait)=="function" then
        return task.wait(t)
    end
    if type(wait)=="function" then return wait(t) end
end

local function safe_len(t)
    local ok,n = pcall(function() return #t end)
    if ok and type(n)=="number" then return n end
    return 0
end
local function safe_rawget(t,k)
    local ok,v = pcall(rawget,t,k)
    if ok then return v end
end
local function hex_encode(s)
    return (s:gsub(".", function(c) return string.format("%02x", string.byte(c)) end))
end
local function safe_tostring(v)
    local ok,r = pcall(tostring,v)
    return ok and r or "<unprintable>"
end
local function readable(s)
    if type(s)~="string" then return false end
    if #s < 2 or #s > MAX_STRING_LEN then return false end
    local p = 0
    for i=1,#s do
        local b = string.byte(s,i)
        if b >= 32 and b < 127 then p = p + 1 end
    end
    return p / #s >= 0.70
end
local function value_signature(v)
    local t = type(v)
    if t=="nil"      then return "nil" end
    if t=="number"   then return "number:"  .. safe_tostring(v) end
    if t=="string"   then return "string_hex:" .. hex_encode(v) end
    if t=="boolean"  then return "boolean:" .. safe_tostring(v) end
    if t=="function" then return "function" end
    if t=="table"    then return "table" end
    if t=="thread"   then return "thread" end
    if t=="userdata" then return "userdata" end
    return t
end

local strings, string_seen = {}, {}
local values, value_seen   = {}, {}
local all_objects, all_seen = {}, {}
local scan_deep_seen = {}

local function add_string(s, source)
    if not readable(s) then return end
    if string_seen[s] then return end
    string_seen[s] = true
    strings[#strings+1] = { value=s, source=source or "unknown" }
end
local function add_value(v, source)
    local sig = value_signature(v)
    if not value_seen[sig] then
        value_seen[sig] = true
        values[#values+1] = { value=sig, source=source or "unknown" }
    end
    if type(v)=="string" then add_string(v, source) end
end
local function add_object(o)
    if o == nil then return false end
    local t = type(o)
    if t~="table" and t~="function" and t~="userdata" then return false end
    if all_seen[o] then return false end
    all_seen[o] = true
    all_objects[#all_objects+1] = o
    return true
end

local TRACREFS_MODE = "none"
local TRACREFS_LAST_OK = false
local function probe_tracrefs()
    if type(tracrefs_fn) ~= "function" then
        return "missing"
    end
    local function good(r) return type(r)=="table" and next(r) ~= nil end

    local ok1, r1 = pcall(tracrefs_fn, _G, 3)
    if ok1 and good(r1) then return "obj_depth" end

    local ok2, r2 = pcall(tracrefs_fn, _G)
    if ok2 and good(r2) then return "obj" end

    local ok3, r3 = pcall(tracrefs_fn)
    if ok3 and good(r3) then return "no_args" end

    if (ok1 and type(r1)=="string")
        or (ok2 and type(r2)=="string")
        or (ok3 and type(r3)=="string") then
        return "string"
    end
    return "unknown"
end
TRACREFS_MODE = probe_tracrefs()

local function collect_via_tracrefs(root, depth)
    if type(tracrefs_fn) ~= "function" then return 0 end
    local ok, r
    if TRACREFS_MODE == "obj_depth" then
        ok, r = pcall(tracrefs_fn, root, depth or 3)
    elseif TRACREFS_MODE == "obj" then
        ok, r = pcall(tracrefs_fn, root)
    elseif TRACREFS_MODE == "no_args" then
        ok, r = pcall(tracrefs_fn)
    elseif TRACREFS_MODE == "string" then
        ok, r = pcall(tracrefs_fn, root, depth or 3)
        if ok and type(r)=="string" then
            emit(OUT_REFS, r)
            TRACREFS_LAST_OK = true
            return 0
        end
        return 0
    else
        local variants = {
            function() return tracrefs_fn(root, depth or 3) end,
            function() return tracrefs_fn(root) end,
            function() return tracrefs_fn() end,
        }
        for _, fn in ipairs(variants) do
            local o, rr = pcall(fn)
            if o and type(rr)=="table" and next(rr) ~= nil then
                ok, r = true, rr; break
            end
        end
    end

    if not ok or r == nil then
        log_err("tracrefs", r)
        return 0
    end

    TRACREFS_LAST_OK = true

    local n = 0
    if type(r) == "table" then
        for i = 1, math.min(#r, 100000) do
            if r[i] ~= nil then add_object(r[i]); n = n + 1 end
        end
        for k, v in pairs(r) do
            if type(k) == "string" and v ~= nil then
                add_object(v); n = n + 1
            elseif type(v) == "string" and k ~= nil then
                add_object(k); n = n + 1
            end
        end
    elseif type(r) == "string" then
        emit(OUT_REFS, r)
    end
    return n
end

local function collect_via_dumpheap()
    if type(dumpheap_fn) ~= "function" then return 0, false end
    local ok, r = pcall(dumpheap_fn)
    if not ok then log_err("dumpheap", r); return 0, false end
    if type(r) == "table" then
        local n = 0
        for i, v in pairs(r) do
            if v ~= nil then add_object(v); n = n + 1
            elseif type(i)=="table" or type(i)=="function" then add_object(i); n = n + 1 end
        end
        return n, true
    elseif type(r) == "string" then
        emit("luraph_dumpheap_raw.txt", r)
        return #r, true
    end
    return 0, false
end

local function walk_reachable(root, max_depth, max_items, source)
    if root == nil then return 0 end
    local seen = {}
    local count = 0
    local stack = { { root, 0, source or "walk" } }

    while #stack > 0 do
        local top = table.remove(stack)
        local o, d, src = top[1], top[2], top[3] or "walk"
        if count >= max_items then break end

        local skip = false
        local t = type(o)
        if d > max_depth then skip = true
        elseif t~="table" and t~="function" and t~="userdata" then skip = true
        elseif seen[o] then skip = true end

        if not skip then
            seen[o] = true
            count = count + 1
            add_object(o)

            if t == "table" then
                local n = 0
                for k, v in pairs(o) do
                    n = n + 1
                    if n > MAX_TABLE_KEYS then break end
                    stack[#stack+1] = { k, d + 1, src .. ":key" }
                    stack[#stack+1] = { v, d + 1, src .. ":value" }
                end
                if type(getrawmetatable)=="function" then
                    local ok2, mt = pcall(getrawmetatable, o)
                    if ok2 and type(mt)=="table" then
                        stack[#stack+1] = { mt, d + 1, src .. ":metatable" }
                    end
                end
            elseif t == "function" then
                if type(getupval_fn)=="function" then
                    local i = 1
                    while true do
                        local name, val = getupval_fn(o, i)
                        if name == nil then break end
                        stack[#stack+1] = { val, d + 1, src .. ":upval_" .. tostring(name) }
                        i = i + 1
                        if i > 512 then break end
                    end
                end
                if type(getfenv_fn)=="function" then
                    local ok2, env = pcall(getfenv_fn, o)
                    if ok2 and type(env)=="table" then
                        stack[#stack+1] = { env, d + 1, src .. ":fenv" }
                    end
                end
            elseif t == "userdata" then
                local ok2, children = pcall(function() return o:GetChildren() end)
                if ok2 and type(children)=="table" then
                    for _, ch in ipairs(children) do
                        stack[#stack+1] = { ch, d + 1, src .. ":child" }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return count
end
local table_seen = {}
local function_seen = {}
local function_count = 0
local scan_table, scan_function

local function array_info(t)
    if type(t)~="table" then return 0,0,0 end
    local len = safe_len(t)
    if len <= 0 then return 0,0,0 end
    local nums, strs = 0, 0
    local lim = math.min(len, MAX_ARRAY_SCAN)
    for i=1,lim do
        local v = safe_rawget(t,i)
        local tv = type(v)
        if tv=="number" then nums = nums + 1
        elseif tv=="string" then strs = strs + 1 end
    end
    return len, nums, strs
end

local function is_numeric_array(t)
    local len, nums = array_info(t)
    if len < 2 then return false end
    return nums >= math.max(2, math.floor(len*0.65))
end

local function parallel_score(t, cf)
    local code = safe_rawget(t, cf)
    if type(code)~="table" then return 0 end
    local cl = safe_len(code)
    if cl < MIN_CODE_LENGTH then return 0 end
    local match, arrs = 0, 0
    for f=1,MAX_FIELD do
        if f ~= cf then
            local v = safe_rawget(t, f)
            if type(v)=="table" then
                arrs = arrs + 1
                local l = safe_len(v)
                if l == cl or math.abs(l-cl) <= 1 then match = match + 1 end
            end
        end
    end
    return match*4 + math.min(arrs, 12)
end

local function proto_score(t, cf)
    if type(t)~="table" then return 0 end
    local code = safe_rawget(t, cf)
    if type(code)~="table" then return 0 end
    local len, nums = array_info(code)
    if len < MIN_CODE_LENGTH then return 0 end

    local score = 5
    if nums >= math.max(2, math.floor(len*0.65)) then score = score + 6 end
    if len >= 4 then score = score + 2 end
    score = score + parallel_score(t, cf)

    local tf, na, pa = 0, 0, 0
    for f=1,MAX_FIELD do
        if f ~= cf then
            local v = safe_rawget(t, f)
            if type(v)=="table" then
                tf = tf + 1
                if is_numeric_array(v) then na = na + 1 end
                local l = math.min(safe_len(v), 256)
                if l >= 2 then
                    local pc = 0
                    for i=1,l do
                        local it = safe_rawget(v,i)
                        local itt = type(it)
                        if itt=="string" or itt=="number"
                           or itt=="boolean" or it==nil then pc = pc + 1 end
                    end
                    if pc >= math.max(2, math.floor(l*0.5)) then pa = pa + 1 end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if tf >= 3 then score = score + 3 end
    if na >= 2 then score = score + 4 end
    if pa >= 2 then score = score + 3 end
    return score
end

local function find_code_field(t)
    local bf, bs = nil, 0
    for f=1,MAX_FIELD do
        local s = proto_score(t, f)
        if s > bs then bs, bf = s, f end
    end
    return bf, bs
end

scan_table = function(t, depth, source)
    if type(t)~="table" then return end
    if depth > MAX_RECURSION then return end
    if table_seen[t] then return end
    table_seen[t] = true
    local n = 0
    for k,v in pairs(t) do
        n = n + 1
        if n > MAX_TABLE_KEYS then break end
        add_value(k, source..":key")
        add_value(v, source..":value")
        if type(k)=="table" then scan_table(k, depth+1, source..":key") end
        if type(v)=="table" then
            scan_table(v, depth+1, source..":value")
        elseif type(v)=="function" then
            scan_function(v, source..":function")
        end
    end
end

scan_function = function(fn, source)
    if type(fn)~="function" then return end
    if function_seen[fn] then return end
    if function_count >= MAX_FN_SCAN then return end
    function_seen[fn] = true
    function_count = function_count + 1

    if type(dbg.getprotos)=="function" then
        local ok, protos = pcall(dbg.getprotos, fn)
        if ok and type(protos)=="table" then
            for _, p in ipairs(protos) do
                if type(p)=="function" then scan_function(p, source..":proto") end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function dump_protos(objects)
    local cands, votes = {}, {}
    for _, o in ipairs(objects) do
        if type(o)=="table" then
            local field, score = find_code_field(o)
            if field and score >= MIN_PROTO_SCORE then
                cands[#cands+1] = { object=o, field=field, score=score }
                votes[field] = (votes[field] or 0) + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if #cands == 0 then return 0,0,0 end

    table.sort(cands, function(a,b) return a.score > b.score end)
    while #cands > MAX_CANDIDATES do cands[#cands] = nil end

    local dom_field, dom_votes = nil, 0
    for f,v in pairs(votes) do
        if v > dom_votes then dom_field, dom_votes = f, v end
    end
    if not dom_field then return 0,0,0 end

    local protos, seen = {}, {}
    for _, c in ipairs(cands) do
        if c.field == dom_field and not seen[c.object] then
            seen[c.object] = true
            protos[#protos+1] = c
        end
    end

    local index = {}
    for id, p in ipairs(protos) do index[p.object] = id end

    local constants, cseen = {}, {}
    local relations, rseen = {}, {}

    for id, p in ipairs(protos) do
        local code = safe_rawget(p.object, p.field)
        if type(code)=="table" then
            local cl = safe_len(code)
            for i=1,cl do
                local op = safe_rawget(code, i)
                local sig = value_signature(op)
                if not cseen[sig] then cseen[sig]=true; constants[#constants+1]=sig end
                for f=1,MAX_FIELD do
                    if f ~= p.field then
                        local arr = safe_rawget(p.object, f)
                        if type(arr)=="table" then
                            local v = safe_rawget(arr, i)
                            add_value(v, "proto:"..id..":f"..f)
                            local vs = value_signature(v)
                            if not cseen[vs] then cseen[vs]=true; constants[#constants+1]=vs end
                            if type(v)=="table" then
                                local child = index[v]
                                if child then
                                    local key = id..":"..child..":"..i..":"..f
                                    if not rseen[key] then
                                        rseen[key] = true
                                        relations[#relations+1] = table.concat({id,child,i,f},"\t")
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local po = {
        "codefield\t"..tostring(dom_field),
        "roots\t"..#protos,
    }
    for id, p in ipairs(protos) do
        local code = safe_rawget(p.object, p.field)
        local cl = safe_len(code)
        po[#po+1] = table.concat({ "proto", id, cl, p.score, p.field }, "\t")
        for i=1,cl do
            local row = { "i", i, value_signature(safe_rawget(code,i)) }
            for f=1,MAX_FIELD do
                if f ~= p.field then
                    local arr = safe_rawget(p.object, f)
                    local v
                    if type(arr)=="table" then v = safe_rawget(arr,i) end
                    row[#row+1] = "f"..f.."="..value_signature(v)
                end
            end
            po[#po+1] = table.concat(row,"\t")
        end
        po[#po+1] = "endproto"
    end
    emit(OUT_PROTOS, table.concat(po,"\n"))

    local oo = { "id\tscore\tcodefield\tcodelen" }
    for id, p in ipairs(protos) do
        local code = safe_rawget(p.object, p.field)
        oo[#oo+1] = table.concat({ id, p.score, p.field, safe_len(code) }, "\t")
    end
    emit(OUT_OBJECTS, table.concat(oo,"\n"))

    local co = { "type\tvalue" }
    for _, c in ipairs(constants) do co[#co+1] = c end
    emit(OUT_CONSTANTS, table.concat(co,"\n"))

    local ro = { "parent\tchild\tinstruction\tfield" }
    for _, r in ipairs(relations) do ro[#ro+1] = r end
    emit(OUT_RELATIONS, table.concat(ro,"\n"))

    return #protos, #constants, #relations
end

local function write_strings()
    table.sort(strings, function(a,b) return a.value < b.value end)
    local o = {}
    for i,e in ipairs(strings) do o[#o+1] = "["..i.."] [string] "..e.value end
    emit(OUT_STRINGS, table.concat(o,"\n"))
end

local function write_values()
    table.sort(values, function(a,b) return a.value < b.value end)
    local o = { "[1] [type] [value]" }
    for i,e in ipairs(values) do
        if #o >= MAX_VALUE_OUTPUT then break end
        o[#o+1] = "["..(i+1).."] ["..e.value.."] "..e.source
    end
    emit(OUT_VALUES, table.concat(o,"\n"))
end

local function write_metadata(pc, cc, rc, roots_info)
    local m = {
        "string_count="   .. #strings,
        "value_count="    .. #values,
        "proto_count="    .. pc,
        "constant_count=" .. cc,
        "relation_count=" .. rc,
        "function_count=" .. function_count,
        "object_pool="    .. #all_objects,
        "key_length="     .. #_LPH_KEY,
        "tracrefs_mode="  .. TRACREFS_MODE,
        "tracrefs_ok="    .. tostring(TRACREFS_LAST_OK),
        "writefile="      .. tostring(writefile_name or "NIL"),
        "getreg="         .. tostring(getreg_name or "NIL"),
    }
    for k, v in pairs(roots_info or {}) do
        m[#m+1] = "root:"..k.."="..v
    end
    emit(OUT_META, table.concat(m,"\n"))
    if #ERRS > 0 then
        emit(OUT_ERRORS, table.concat(ERRS, "\n"))
    end
end

spawn(function()
    warn_fn("[dump] phase 1 — load")
    local fn, err = loadstring(SRC, "=luraph")
    if not fn then
        warn_fn("[dump] loadstring failed: "..tostring(err))
        emit(OUT_DEBUG, "loadstring failed: "..tostring(err))
        return
    end

    warn_fn("[dump] phase 2 — execute")
    local ok, result = pcall(fn)
    warn_fn("[dump] executed="..tostring(ok).." ret_type="..type(result))
    if not ok then
        warn_fn("[dump] error: "..tostring(result))
        log_err("exec", result)
    end

    wait_(2)

    warn_fn("[dump] phase 3 — collect")
    local roots_info = {}

    if result ~= nil then
        add_object(result)
        local n = collect_via_tracrefs(result, 5)
        roots_info["ret_tracrefs"] = n
        local w = walk_reachable(result, 8, MAX_WALK_ITEMS, "ret")
        roots_info["ret_walk"] = w
        warn_fn("[dump] ret traced="..n.." walked="..w)
    end

    local nfn = collect_via_tracrefs(fn, 5)
    roots_info["fn_tracrefs"] = nfn
    local wfn = walk_reachable(fn, 8, MAX_WALK_ITEMS, "fn")
    roots_info["fn_walk"] = wfn
    warn_fn("[dump] fn traced="..nfn.." walked="..wfn)

    local wg = walk_reachable(GENV, 5, MAX_WALK_ITEMS, "genv")
    roots_info["genv_walk"] = wg
    local wgg = walk_reachable(_G, 5, MAX_WALK_ITEMS, "gg")
    roots_info["gg_walk"] = wgg
    warn_fn("[dump] genv walked="..wg.." _G walked="..wgg)

    if type(getfenv_fn)=="function" then
        local okf, env = pcall(getfenv_fn, fn)
        if okf and type(env)=="table" then
            local we = walk_reachable(env, 6, MAX_WALK_ITEMS, "fn_env")
            roots_info["fn_env_walk"] = we
        end
    end

    if getreg_fn then
        local okr, reg = pcall(getreg_fn)
        if okr and type(reg)=="table" then
            local wr = walk_reachable(reg, 4, MAX_WALK_ITEMS, "registry")
            roots_info["registry_walk"] = wr
            warn_fn("[dump] registry walked="..wr)
        else
            log_err("getreg", reg)
        end
    end

    local nh, hok = collect_via_dumpheap()
    roots_info["dumpheap_count"] = nh
    roots_info["dumpheap_ok"]    = tostring(hok)

    local ls_count = 0
    if type(game)=="table" and type(game.GetDescendants)=="function" then
        local okd, descs = pcall(function() return game:GetDescendants() end)
        if okd and type(descs)=="table" then
            for _, inst in ipairs(descs) do
                add_object(inst)
            end
            roots_info["game_descendants"] = #descs
            warn_fn("[dump] game descendants="..#descs)
            if getclosure_fn then
                for _, inst in ipairs(descs) do
                    local okc, cls = pcall(function() return inst.ClassName end)
                    if okc and (cls == "LocalScript" or cls == "ModuleScript") then
                        local okf, f = pcall(getclosure_fn, inst)
                        if okf and type(f)=="function" then
                            collect_via_tracrefs(f, 4)
                            walk_reachable(f, 6, MAX_WALK_ITEMS, "script:"..tostring(cls))
                            scan_function(f, "script:"..tostring(cls))
                            ls_count = ls_count + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    roots_info["scripts_scanned"] = ls_count

    if getnilinst_fn then
        local okn, ni = pcall(getnilinst_fn)
        if okn and type(ni)=="table" then
            for _, o in ipairs(ni) do add_object(o) end
            roots_info["nil_instances"] = #ni
        end
    end

    if getinsts_fn then
        local oki, list = pcall(getinsts_fn)
        if oki and type(list)=="table" then
            for _, o in ipairs(list) do add_object(o) end
            roots_info["all_instances"] = #list
        end
    end

    warn_fn("[dump] object pool: "..#all_objects)

    warn_fn("[dump] phase 4 — deep scan")
    add_string(SRC, "embedded_source")
    scan_function(fn, "executed_function")

    for _, o in ipairs(all_objects) do
        local t = type(o)
        if t == "table" then
            if not scan_deep_seen[o] then
                scan_deep_seen[o] = true
                scan_table(o, 0, "pool:table")
            end
        elseif t == "function" then
            scan_function(o, "pool:function")
        end
    end

    warn_fn("[dump] phase 5 — score protos")
    local pc, cc, rc = dump_protos(all_objects)

    write_strings()
    write_values()
    write_metadata(pc, cc, rc, roots_info)

    warn_fn(("[dump] done | strings=%d values=%d protos=%d constants=%d relations=%d")
        :format(#strings, #values, pc, cc, rc))
end)
